stories.title: Montanha de dinheiro: sargento aposentado da PM e suspeitos de agiotagem cobravam juros de até 20%, diz polícia

en.title: Mountain of money: retired PM sergeant and loan shark suspects charged interest up to 20%, police say
en.summary: Police report that a criminal lending group led by retired military police sergeant José Luiz Silva Sá charged monthly interest rates of up to 20% and used violent collection methods. Video evidence shows one suspect displaying large amounts of cash.

stories.title: Flávio investigado, dinheiro de Toffoli e diretor ‘anjo’: o que o fim do sigilo do Master revela

en.title: Flávio under investigation, Toffoli's money and 'angel' director: what the end of Master's confidentiality reveals
en.summary: The release of confidential information related to the Master investigation reveals details involving political and judicial figures under scrutiny.

stories.title: Inmet emite alerta para risco de tempestade no Vale e região; temperaturas devem cair no fim de semana

en.title: Inmet issues alert for storm risk in Vale and region; temperatures to drop at weekend
en.summary: Brazil's National Meteorology Institute issued a storm alert for the Paraíba Valley region from Saturday through Monday. A cold front arriving Sunday is expected to increase rainfall and lower temperatures.

stories.title: Stray kids faz show mais contido no dia de k-pop no Rock in Rio, marcado por aglomerações

en.title: Stray Kids performs on k-pop day at Rock in Rio, marked by overcrowding
en.summary: K-pop group Stray Kids delivered the most crowded main stage performance of this year's Rock in Rio during the festival's Korean pop music day. The high attendance created significant congestion at the venue.

stories.title: Stray Kids faz show de gente grande no Rock in Rio e mostra os caminhos do futuro da música

en.title: Stray Kids puts on a grown-up show at Rock in Rio and shows the paths of the future of music
en.summary: Stray Kids performed at Rock in Rio festival, delivering a mature performance that highlighted emerging directions in contemporary music.

stories.title: K-pop no Rock in Rio, com Stray Kids e sem esgotar ingressos, apresenta a uma geração a experiência de um festival

en.title: K-pop at Rock in Rio, with Stray Kids and without selling out tickets, presents a generation with the experience of a festival
en.summary: Rock in Rio hosted a K-pop focused event featuring Stray Kids on Friday, offering festival experience to a generation as the event's format differed from previous days that ended with Elton John.

stories.title: Lady Gaga dá a luz ao primeiro filho, diz imprensa americana

en.title: Lady Gaga gives birth to her first child, says American press
en.summary: Lady Gaga has given birth to her first child, according to reports from American media outlets.

stories.title: Stray Kids: Confira provável setlist de grupo no Rock in Rio

en.title: Stray Kids: Check the probable setlist for the group at Rock in Rio
en.summary: Information about Stray Kids' expected performance schedule at the Rock in Rio music festival is provided.

stories.title: SP: Defesa Civil emite alerta severo com condição para granizo neste sábado (12)

en.title: SP: Civil Defense issues severe alert with conditions for hail this Saturday (12)
en.summary: An extratropical cyclone is causing instability across Brazil with cold and rainy weather. São Paulo's Civil Defense issued a severe alert for heavy rain, intense wind gusts, and hail conditions on Saturday.

stories.title: Quebra de sigilo do Master expõe Flávio Bolsonaro investigado e gera nova troca de ataques no STF

en.title: Master bank secrecy breach exposes investigated Flávio Bolsonaro and generates new exchange of attacks at STF
en.summary: The lifting of confidentiality in the Master Bank investigation case has exposed Flávio Bolsonaro under investigation and triggered renewed conflict among Supreme Court justices amid efforts to resolve institutional tensions.

stories.title: Lady Gaga e Michael Polansky têm primeiro filho, diz site

en.title: Lady Gaga and Michael Polansky have first child, says website
en.summary: Lady Gaga, 40, and her fiancé Michael Polansky, 42, welcomed their first child together, according to Page Six. The outlet published photos of the singer with a baby, though details about the child's name, sex, and birth date have not been disclosed.

stories.title: Alok toca k-pop e levanta fãs do Stray Kids com set de festa de formatura no Rock in Rio

en.title: Alok plays k-pop and energizes Stray Kids fans with graduation party set at Rock in Rio
en.summary: Brazilian DJ Alok performed at Rock in Rio festival, incorporating k-pop into his electronic music set. His performance featured characteristic elements of electronic dance music including buildup, visual effects, and the signature 'drop' moment that engaged the audience.

stories.title: Cúpula do Brics começa na Índia com o desafio de conciliar tensões entre Irã e Emirados Árabes Unidos

en.title: Brics summit begins in India with challenge of reconciling tensions between Iran and United Arab Emirates
en.summary: Leaders of Brics nations gathered in India for a two-day summit facing difficulties in issuing a joint statement amid friction between two member states, Iran and the United Arab Emirates, due to ongoing tensions in the Persian Gulf.

stories.title: Produtora de 'Dark Horse' impôs multa e contrato 'irrevogável' a trabalhadores

en.title: Producer of 'Dark Horse' imposed fine and 'irrevocable' contract on workers
en.summary: Production company Go Up required workers on the film 'Dark Horse' to sign confidentiality agreements featuring a 1 million real penalty and perpetual obligations to maintain secrecy about the film and company. Federal Police investigators received these contracts while investigating film financing by former Banco Master controller Daniel Vorcaro.

stories.title: Defesa de Flávio tentou 4 vezes tirar de Dino investigação sobre "Dark Horse"

en.title: Flávio's defense attempted 4 times to remove investigation about 'Dark Horse' from Dino
en.summary: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team made four attempts to transfer an investigation from Minister Flávio Dino to Minister André Mendonça regarding parliamentary amendment funds directed to entities linked to the 'Dark Horse' film producer.

stories.title: Vorcaro gastou US$ 55 milhões em turismo de luxo em um ano, mostra relatório do Coaf

en.title: Vorcaro spent US$ 55 million on luxury tourism in one year, shows Coaf report
en.summary: Documents from the Banco Master investigation reveal that former banker Daniel Vorcaro spent US$ 55.3 million in less than a year on luxury tourism services through a company, using funds from a Bahamas-based broker, according to a financial intelligence report from Brazil's central bank authority.

stories.title: Presidente da Febraban depositou R$ 700 mil em conta de firma ligada a Vorcaro e Zettel, diz Coaf

en.title: Febraban president deposited R$ 700 thousand in account linked to Vorcaro and Zettel, says Coaf
en.summary: A report indicates that the president of Brazil's banking federation deposited R$ 700 thousand into an account connected to former banker Daniel Vorcaro and his brother-in-law, transferred electronically one day after the account was opened at a credit cooperative branch.
